title: a desktop-style live app (sidebar, main view, player bar): its text stays inside its boxes and its caption reads
note: A wireframe of a music app was written as a live app laid out for 13 to 14 px type, and set in the stage's own large type: the logo wrapped and was cut off, labels overlapped, the player buttons were blank boxes and the caption beside it was cut off. A sidebar with a main view is a page, not a little app, and keeps its own type; a wireframe asked for is now a mock-up.

turns.say: can you help me wireframe up a spotify clone
